Here is your Certificate of Visa Eligibility application, filled in for you as the applicant. The form asks for block letters, so once the real values are back, check that every name and address is written in capitals.

**1. Personal details**

- [B01] Family Name: RAGHUNATHAN
- [B02] Given Names: VIKRAM ANAND
- [B03] Chinese-character name: leave blank (not applicable)
- [B04] Sex: Male [√]
- [B05] Date of Birth: 22/11/1983. Rewrite it by hand as yyyy/mm/dd if your passport prints it another way (for example 1985/03/07).
- [B06] Nationality: INDIAN
- [B07] Country of Birth: PUNE, MAHARASHTRA. If this holds a town or city, keep only the country name.
- [B08] National Identity No.: NEEDS-YOU. Your Indian national ID number isn't in the list (your passport number doesn't count). Write it on the form yourself, or leave it blank if the office says you don't need it.
- [B09] Other names used to enter or leave Korea: NEEDS-YOU. Tick No if you've never been to Korea, or never used a different name there.
- [B10] More than one citizenship: NEEDS-YOU. India doesn't normally allow dual citizenship, so this is usually No, but tick it yourself.

**2. Passport information**

- [B11] Passport Type: Regular [√]. This assumes an ordinary passport, so please check it isn't Diplomatic or Official.
- [B12] Passport No.: Z4827163
- [B13] Country of Passport: INDIA
- [B14] Place of Issue: HIGH COMMISSION OF INDIA, LONDON. Check this matches the "Place of Issue" printed in your passport. If it doesn't, write that place in by hand.
- [B15] Date of Issue: 05/06/2019. To match the rest of the form, you can rewrite it as yyyy/mm/dd.
- [B16] Date of Expiry: 2029/06/04
- [B17] Any other valid passport: NEEDS-YOU. Indian citizens normally hold only one, so this is usually No.

**3. Contact information**

- [B18] Home Country Address: NEEDS-YOU. This means your address in India, which isn't listed. If you no longer have one, write 14 Quillon Mews, Didsbury, Manchester M20 6QX, United Kingdom here and leave 3.2 blank.
- [B19] Current Residential Address: 14 Quillon Mews, Didsbury, Manchester M20 6QX, United Kingdom
- [B20] Cell Phone No.: +44 7700 900123. Add the country code (+44) by hand if it isn't already there.
- [B21] Telephone No.: NEEDS-YOU. Give a landline if you have one, or leave it blank.
- [B22] E-mail: NEEDS-YOU. Your email address isn't listed.
- [B23] Emergency contact, Full Name: RAGHUNATHAN MEERA
- [B24] Country of Residence: UNITED KINGDOM
- [B25] Telephone No.: +44 7700 900456. Add +44 if needed.
- [B26] Relationship: WIFE

**4. Marital status and family**

- [B27] Marital Status: Married [√]
- [B28] Spouse Family Name: RAGHUNATHAN
- [B29] Spouse Given Names: MEERA
- [B30] Spouse Date of Birth: 03/02/1986. Rewrite it as yyyy/mm/dd if needed.
- [B31] Spouse Nationality: INDIAN
- [B32] Spouse Residential Address: 14 Quillon Mews, Didsbury, Manchester M20 6QX, United Kingdom (you live together)
- [B33] Spouse Contact No.: +44 7700 900456
- [B34] Children: Yes [√], Number of children: 1

**5. Education**

- [B35] Highest degree: Master's/Doctoral Degree [√]
- [B36] Name of School: NEEDS-YOU. The university for your master's isn't listed.
- [B37] Location of School: NEEDS-YOU. Give its city, province and country.

**6. Employment**

- [B38] Current circumstances: Employed [√]
- [B39] Name of Company: NEEDS-YOU. Your employer's name isn't listed.
- [B40] Position: NEEDS-YOU. Your job title isn't listed.
- [B41] Company Address: NEEDS-YOU. Give your current office's address.
- [B42] Company Telephone No.: NEEDS-YOU

**Other points**
- This copy stops at section 6. The full application usually goes on to ask about the purpose of your stay and your sponsor or inviting company in Korea. Your Seoul office or HR team can normally provide those details.
- This application covers only you. If your wife and daughter join you later, they'll normally need their own dependant applications. Your daughter's passport expires on 1 January 2027, so it may be worth renewing it before she applies.
